svg.aria-label: A family tree: the six masters above, the resizes below, each joined to the one or two masters it is blended from, and under them 335 resizes in all; the 6:5 magnified, its hero nudged down and scaled clear of the headline
svg.text: MASTERS → RESIZES, EACH ONE LAID OUT
Where the blend put the hero (dashed) is under
the headline: nudged clear, then scaled.
